cards.text:
沃格尔·三重咒魔 APL 移动豁免耐伤
2 5" 5+ 21
名称攻击命中伤害武器规则
喷火胃炉（标准） 5 2+ 3/3 范围 6"、集中、洪流 2"
喷火胃炉（喷流） 5 2+ 3/3 范围 4"、集中、追踪轻型
融合武器 5 3+ 4/5 改造*
散播伟大馈赠：每场战斗限一次，战略计划。选择
一个目标标识，使其获得一个您的科技诅咒标识。
目标标识在被选择时不能位于一名敌方特工的控制
范围内。每当那个目标标识位于一名敌方特工控制
范围内，则那名特工受到您选择的科技诅咒规则影
响，并会根据您选择的科技诅咒规则额外受到下列
影响。您不能在这名特工位于一名敌方特工控制范
围内时使用这个战略计划。
• 枪管扭曲：没有额外效果。
• 尖啸锈尖：尖啸锈尖对那名敌方特工造成 2 点伤
害（而不是 1 点）。
• 传染性通讯声噪：每当那名特工激活时，在它的
激活结束前将其 APL 属性降低 1 点。
请继续阅读背面规则
盖勒痘魔、混沌、噩梦巨物、队长、沃格尔·三重咒魔 40

Spread the Glorious Gifts: Once per battle STRATEGIC

cards.text:
盖勒痘魔
阵营规则
科技诅咒
盖勒痘瘟是一种险恶的科技诅咒，它会渗入沉
思者系统内以及机械组件之中，将其诡异的馈
赠散播给毫无防备之人。
在选择特工步骤结束时，为己方盖勒痘魔特工
在本场战斗中选择一个科技诅咒。每当一名敌方
特工位于您选择的科技诅咒的感染范围内时，那
名敌方特工受到科技诅咒的症状效果影响。每一
个科技诅咒，以及它们的感染范围和症状如下：
请继续阅读背面
cards.text_en:
GELLERPOX INFECTED
FACTION RULE
TECHNO-CURSE
The Gellerpox is an insidious techno-curse that
wends its way into cogitator systems and mechanical
components, spreading its dubious gifts to
the unsuspecting.
At the end of the Select Operatives step, select
one TECHNO-CURSE for friendly GELLERPOX
INFECTED operatives to gain for the battle.
Whenever an enemy operative is within your
selected TECHNO-CURSE’s infection range, that
enemy operative is affected by the symptom of the
selected TECHNO-CURSE. Each TECHNO-CURSE,
its infection range and its symptom is listed below:
CONTINUES ON OTHER SIDE

cards.text:
枪管扭曲
随着盖勒痘瘟感染了远程武器，其枪管开始扭
曲，膛线开始腐化，杀伤力也随之变得低下。
感染范围：己方盖勒痘魔特工（变异害虫除
外）的 2" 内，或者己方盖勒痘魔故障灵特工
的 3" 内。
症状：将那名敌方特工的远程武器攻击属性减
去 1 点。
尖啸锈尖
敌人装备的刀具开始奇怪的扭曲起来，甚至从
其握持之处迸出尖刺，扎穿持有者的血肉。
感染范围：己方盖勒痘魔特工（变异害虫除
外）的控制范围内。
症状：每当那名敌方特工对一名己方盖勒痘魔
特工进行近战或反击时，若您的对手因为失败而
弃置任意数量的攻击骰子，那名敌方特工便受到
1 点伤害。
请继续阅读背面
cards.text_en:
Barrelwarp
As the Gellerpox infects ranged weapons, it warps
barrels and corrodes rifling, reducing the effectiveness
of such weapons.
Infection Range: Within 2" of a friendly
GELLERPOX INFECTED operative (excluding
MUTOID VERMIN), or within 3" of a friendly
GELLERPOX INFECTED GLITCHLING operative.
Symptom: Subtract 1 from the Atk stat of that
enemy operative’s ranged weapons.
Screaming Rustspikes
Blades equipped by the enemy become strange and
twisted, with spikes bursting from sword grips to pierce
the flesh of the wielder.
Infection Range: Within control range of a friendly
GELLERPOX INFECTED operative (excluding
MUTOID VERMIN).
Symptom: Whenever that enemy operative
is fighting or retaliating against a friendly
GELLERPOX INFECTED operative, if your
opponent discards any attack dice as a fail, inflict
1 damage on that enemy operative.
CONTINUES ON OTHER SIDE

cards.text:
传染性通讯声噪
不谐的静电噪音以及扎耳的尖叫不断通过通讯
频道传出，通过对通讯的干扰，敌方的指挥链
被打断，恐惧在队伍中不断散播。
感染范围：己方盖勒痘魔特工（变异害虫除
外）的 3" 内，或者己方盖勒痘魔故障灵特工
的 4" 内。
症状：那名敌方特工的 APL 属性无法被增加
（将它拥有的所有正向 APL 修正移除）。
cards.text_en:
Viral Vox-static
Discordant static noise and ear-piercing screams
blare over vox-channels, disrupting the enemy’s
communications, breaking their chain of command and
sowing fear within their ranks.
Infection Range: Within 3" of a friendly
GELLERPOX INFECTED operative (excluding
MUTOID VERMIN), or within 4" of a friendly
GELLERPOX INFECTED GLITCHLING operative.
Symptom: That enemy operative’s APL stat
cannot be added to (remove all positive APL stat
changes it has).

cards.text:
盖勒痘魔
阵营规则
变异害虫
在盖勒痘瘟的影响下，这些小虫们成为了巨大
威胁。但对训练有素的士兵而言，它们依然不
过是一些蛆虫。
变异害虫特工无法执行除冲锋，冲刺，后撤，近
战，转移和射击外的任何行动，并无法使用任何
其数据卡上没有的武器。并且它们可以在执行后
撤行动时减少 1 AP 消耗。
变异害虫特工无法争夺标识或杀戮区区域，且在
您对手的击杀/歼灭任务（当它们残废和确定您起
始特工数量时）被忽视。同时，它们在需要确定
特工是否“逃脱”，“存活”或被敌方特工残废
（在需要确认必须“逃脱”/“存活”/被敌方特
工残废数量时，它们成功“逃脱”/“存活”或被
敌方特工残废的情况下）的胜利条件和 VP 获取
方式中也会被忽视。
请继续阅读背面
cards.text_en:
GELLERPOX INFECTED
FACTION RULE
MUTOID VERMIN
Tiny pests become monstrous threats under the effects
of the Gellerpox, but are still grubs that can be ignored
by highly trained warriors.
MUTOID VERMIN operatives cannot perform any
actions other than Charge, Dash, Fall Back, Fight,
Reposition and Shoot, or use any weapons that
aren’t on their datacard. They can perform the
Fall Back action for 1 less AP.
MUTOID VERMIN operatives cannot contest
markers or areas of the killzone, and are ignored
for your opponent’s kill/elimination op (when
they're incapacitated, and when determining
your starting number of operatives). They're also
ignored for victory conditions and scoring VPs
if either require operatives to ‘escape’, ‘survive’
or be incapacitated by enemy operatives (if they
escape/survive/are incapacitated, determining
how many operatives must escape/survive/be
incapacitated, etc.).
CONTINUES ON OTHER SIDE

cards.text:
特工可以移动穿过变异害虫特工，并且敌方特工
可以移动进入它们的控制范围内。位于变异害虫
特工控制范围内不会阻止敌方特工执行冲锋、冲
刺和转移行动，并且敌方特工可以在执行冲锋行
动时离开变异害虫特工的控制范围。
cards.text_en:
Operatives can move through MUTOID VERMIN
operatives, and enemy operatives can move
within control range of them. Having only
MUTOID VERMIN operatives within their control
range doesn't prevent enemy operatives from
performing the Charge, Dash and Reposition
action, and enemy operatives can leave MUTOID
VERMIN operatives' control range when
performing the Charge action.

cards.text:
盖勒痘魔
阵营规则
噩梦巨物
一部分感染者的形体会在纳垢的丰厚赐福下肿
胀成巨大的扭曲生物。尽管通过这种变异它们
获得了强大的力量，但动作变得笨拙了。
每当您的对手在选择有效目标时，己方盖勒痘魔
噩梦巨物特工无法使用轻型地形作为掩护。尽
管本规则能使这类特工成为目标（假设可见），
但并不会移除它们的掩护豁免（如果有）。
己方盖勒痘魔噩梦巨物特工不能执行独特行
动。在执行拾取标识和任务行动（操作舱门除
外）时，己方盖勒痘魔噩梦巨物特工（沃格
尔·三重咒魔除外）必须额外消耗 1 点 AP。
cards.text_en:
GELLERPOX INFECTED
FACTION RULE
NIGHTMARE HULKS
Several among the infected have had their forms
bloated and swollen into enormous twisted creatures,
blessed with the bounteous gifts of Nurgle. Though
made powerful by such mutations, these monstrosities
are somewhat clumsy in their movements.
Whenever your opponent is selecting a valid
target, friendly GELLERPOX INFECTED
NIGHTMARE HULK operatives cannot use Light
terrain for cover. While this can allow such
operatives to be targeted (assuming they’re
visible), it doesn’t remove their cover save
(if any).
Friendly GELLERPOX INFECTED NIGHTMARE
HULK operatives cannot perform unique
actions. You must spend 1 additional AP for
friendly GELLERPOX INFECTED NIGHTMARE
HULK operatives (excluding VULGRAR THRICE-
CURSED) to perform the Pick Up Marker and
mission actions (excluding Operate Hatch).

cards.text:
盖勒痘魔
阵营规则
恶心坚韧
这些笨重畸变体通过可怕变异产生的诡异生理
结构能够抵抗大量伤害。
每当一枚攻击骰子对一名己方盖勒痘魔噩梦巨
物特工或一名己方盖勒痘魔变种人特工造成 3
点或更多伤害时，便掷一枚 D6：若掷骰结果为
4+，将其造成的伤害减去 1 点。
cards.text_en:
GELLERPOX INFECTED
FACTION RULE
REVOLTINGLY RESILIENT
The monstrous transformations wrought upon these
hulking brutes have rendered their aberrant physiologies
incredibly resistant to harm.
Whenever an attack dice inflicts damage of 3
or more on a friendly GELLERPOX INFECTED
NIGHTMARE HULK or GELLERPOX INFECTED
MUTANT operative, roll one D6: on a 4+, subtract
1 from that inflicted damage.

cards.text:
盖勒痘魔
战略计谋
疫然决然
纳垢的赐福导致他们的躯体膨胀溃烂，同时也
使他们获得超自然的坚韧。
每当一名特工对拥有交战命令的一名己方盖勒痘
魔特工（变异害虫除外）执行射击时，您可以
重掷一枚己方防御掷骰。
cards.text_en:
GELLERPOX INFECTED
STRATEGY PLOY
PLAGUERIDDEN DETERMINATION
Nurgle’s blessings cause the body to bloat and fester,
bestowing an unnatural resilience upon the recipient.
Whenever an operative is shooting a friendly
GELLERPOX INFECTED operative (excluding
MUTOID VERMIN) that has an Engage order, you
can re-roll one of your defence dice.

cards.text:
盖勒痘魔
战略计谋
感染的祝福
盖勒痘瘟的变异特性和腐化影响能赋予感染者
凶残的力量和决心带来的愉悦。
当一名己方盖勒痘魔特工处于近战或反击时，
您可以进行以下一种行动：
• 如果您在掷骰中出现三次或更多失败时，您可
以舍弃其中一次失败并将另一次失败作为普通
成功进行保留。
• 如果您掷出三次或更多成功，那么您可以舍弃
一次失败并将一次普通成功作为关键成功进行
保留。
cards.text_en:
GELLERPOX INFECTED
STRATEGY PLOY
BLESSINGS OF INFECTION
The mutagenic properties and corrupting influence
of the Gellerpox lend the infected brutal strength and
gleeful determination.
Whenever a friendly GELLERPOX INFECTED
operative is fighting or retaliating, you can do one
of the following:
• If you roll three or more fails, you can discard
one of them to retain another as a normal
success instead.
• If you roll three or more successes, you can
discard one of your fails to retain one of your
normal successes as a critical success instead.

cards.text:
盖勒痘魔
战略计谋
被震动吸引
机械轻柔的轰鸣声对感染者有着难以抵挡的吸
引力，就如同昆虫会被亮堂的灯光吸引一样。
选择一个目标标识。每当一名己方盖勒痘魔特
工在它的激活中执行转移或冲锋行动时，您便可
以使用这个技能。若此，在那次激活结束前将它
的移动属性增加 1"，但在结束那次移动时，特工
必须位于那个目标标识的 2" 内。
cards.text_en:
GELLERPOX INFECTED
STRATEGY PLOY
DRAWN TO THE HUM
The gentle thrum of machinery has an irresistible effect
upon the infected, pulling them in like insects drawn to
a blazing lumen.
Select one objective marker. Whenever a friendly
GELLERPOX INFECTED operative performs the
Reposition or Charge action during its activation,
you can use this rule. If you do, add 1" to its Move
stat until the end of that activation, but it must
end that move within 2" of that objective marker.

cards.text:
盖勒痘魔
战略计谋
锈化放射
臃肿的噩梦巨物飘散出感染气息，这股环绕
其身的腐臭光环能够腐蚀并破坏周围进攻者
的武器。
每当一名己方盖勒痘魔特工（变异害虫除外）
进行近战或反击时，您的对手不能将结果为 3 的
掷骰作为成功进行保留。
cards.text_en:
GELLERPOX INFECTED
STRATEGY PLOY
RUST EMANATIONS
Bloated Nightmare Hulks are redolent with infection,
surrounded by a halo of foetid energy that corrodes and
corrupts the weaponry of nearby assailants.
Whenever a friendly GELLERPOX INFECTED
operative (excluding MUTOID VERMIN) is fighting
or retaliating, your opponent cannot retain results
of 3 as successes.

cards.text:
盖勒痘魔
交战计谋
恶心科技
盖勒痘魔的感染触手腐蚀了机械，导致各种武
器和器械对其操纵者极为危险。
当一名敌方特工对一名己方盖勒痘魔特工执行
射击时，使用本交战计谋。那名特工的远程武器
在那次流程结束前获得“过热”武器规则；如果
对应武器已经拥有那个武器规则，则在您的对手
为那个武器规则掷一枚 D6 时，您可以为结果增
加或减去 1 点。请注意，对于后者，您可以在您
对手为“过热”武器规则掷骰产生结果后再决定
是否使用这个计谋。
cards.text_en:
GELLERPOX INFECTED
FIREFIGHT PLOY
REVOLTING TECHNOLOGY
The Gellerpox’s infectious tendrils reach out to corrupt
the mechanical, rendering weapons and machinery
dangerous to their operators.
Use this firefight ploy when an enemy operative
is shooting a friendly GELLERPOX INFECTED
operative. That operative’s ranged weapons
have the Hot weapon rule until the end of that
sequence; if the weapon already has that weapon
rule, when your opponent rolls one D6 for that
weapon rule, you can add or subtract 1 from the
result. Note that for the latter you can see the
result of your opponent’s roll for the Hot weapon
rule before deciding to use this ploy.

cards.text:
盖勒痘魔
交战计谋
冲撞
噩梦巨物的庞大身躯能将横亘于目标前的各种
敌人和障碍撞到一边。
当一名己方盖勒痘魔噩梦巨物特工被激活或反
应时，执行行动的之前或之后使用本交战计谋。
在那次激活/反应中：
• 它可以移动穿过敌方特工以及位于它们控制范
围内。
• 它可以在控制范围内有一名敌方特工时执行冲
锋和转移行动，并且可以因此离开那名敌方特
工的控制范围内（但那次移动的随后过程中依
然受限于普通规则）。
cards.text_en:
GELLERPOX INFECTED
FIREFIGHT PLOY
BARGE
The enormous bodies of the Nightmare Hulks allow them
to barge enemies and obstructions aside to achieve
their objective.
Use this firefight ploy during a friendly
GELLERPOX INFECTED NIGHTMARE HULK
operative’s activation or counteraction, before or
after it performs an action. During that activation/
counteraction:
• It can move through enemy operatives and
within control range of them.
• It can perform the Charge and Reposition
actions while within control range of an enemy
operative, and can leave that operative’s
control range to do so (but then normal
requirements for that move apply).

cards.text:
盖勒痘魔
交战计谋
腐烂之死
随着盖勒痘魔死去，它们的尸体会在一片满载
疾病的高危酸性血肉爆破中消逝，并由此伤害
波及的一切。
当一名己方盖勒痘魔特工（变异害虫除外）残
废时，在将其移出杀戮区前使用本交战计谋。位
于那名己方特工 2" 内的每一名敌方特工受到 1
点伤害（如果那名己方特工为噩梦巨物，则受到
D3 点伤害作为替代）。
cards.text_en:
GELLERPOX INFECTED
FIREFIGHT PLOY
PUTRESCENT DEMISE
As a Gellerpox Infected perishes, their body explodes
in a shower of acrid disease and hazardous gore that
harms all caught in its blast.
Use this firefight ploy when a friendly GELLERPOX
INFECTED operative (excluding MUTOID
VERMIN) is incapacitated, before it’s removed
from the killzone. Inflict 1 damage (or D3 damage
instead if that friendly operative is a NIGHTMARE
HULK) on each enemy operative visible to and
within 2" of that friendly operative.

cards.text:
盖勒痘魔
交战计谋
可怕猛攻
噩梦巨物能够以恐怖的攻击速度进行无间断
的打击。
当一名己方盖勒痘魔噩梦巨物特工执行近战行
动后没有残废时使用本交战计谋。它可以立即执
行一次无消耗的近战行动（您并非必须选择同
一名敌方特工进行近战）。本规则优先于行动
限制。
cards.text_en:
GELLERPOX INFECTED
FIREFIGHT PLOY
FRIGHTENING ONSLAUGHT
Nightmare Hulks can strike without pause, with
terrifying speed.
Use this firefight ploy after a friendly GELLERPOX
INFECTED NIGHTMARE HULK operative
performs the Fight action, if it isn't incapacitated.
It can immediately perform a free Fight action
(you don't have to select the same enemy
operative to fight against). This takes precedence
over action restrictions.

cards.text:
盖勒痘魔
阵营装备
变异害虫
被盖勒痘瘟感染的老鼠，蠕虫，昆虫或是其他
污秽生物会与感染它们的主人并肩作战。
在揭示这个装备选项后，为己方参与本场战斗的
杀戮小队增加 4 名盖勒痘魔变异害虫特工。
cards.text_en:
GELLERPOX INFECTED
FACTION EQUIPMENT
MUTOID VERMIN
Rats, worms, insectile vermin and other foul creatures
blighted by the Gellerpox swarm to fight at the side of
their infected masters.
After revealing this equipment option, add
four GELLERPOX INFECTED MUTOID VERMIN
operatives to your kill team for the battle.

cards.text:
盖勒痘魔
阵营装备
污损库存
随着防卫者准备击退入侵，他们发现自己的武
器已被盖勒痘瘟传染腐化。
在揭示这个装备选项后，掷 2D6：若掷骰结果为
7+，则移除您的对手的一个装备选项；在其他情
况下，那名玩家自行选择移除一个装备选项。他
们不能再次在那个游戏流程中选择那个装备（例
如认证行动的侦查阶段中），您不能在选择特工
阶段后选择这个装备选项。
cards.text_en:
GELLERPOX INFECTED
FACTION EQUIPMENT
POLLUTED STOCKPILE
As defenders prepare to repel the infected, they find
their own weapons and equipment degraded by the
Gellerpox’s corroding influence.
After revealing this equipment option, roll 2D6:
on a 7+, remove one of your opponent’s selected
equipment options; otherwise, that player
removes one of their own selected equipment
options. They cannot select that equipment
again during the game sequence (e.g. in the
Scouting step of Approved Ops). You cannot
select this equipment option after the Select
Operatives step.

cards.text:
盖勒痘魔
阵营装备
突变病征
盖勒痘瘟产生的症状千变万化，有些感染者
会展现出多种变异，每一种都会比前者更为
丑恶。
每场战斗限一次，当您激活一名己方盖勒痘魔
特工时，您可以使那名特工在这个转折点结束
前获得额外的一个科技诅咒（这个选项必须与您
现存的科技诅咒不同）。请注意，如果有规则提
到一名受到己方科技诅咒规则效果影响的敌方特
工（例如沃格尔·三重咒魔特工的‘散布伟大馈
赠’规则），那么敌方特工同样会受到这个额外
的科技诅咒影响。
cards.text_en:
GELLERPOX INFECTED
FACTION EQUIPMENT
MUTATED SYMPTOMS
The effects of the Gellerpox are many and varied; some
infected display multiple mutations, each one more
grotesque than the last.
Once per battle, when you activate a friendly
GELLERPOX INFECTED operative, you can select
one additional TECHNO-CURSE for that operative
to gain until the end of the turning point (it must
be different from your existing TECHNO-CURSE).
Note that if a rule refers to an enemy operative
being affected by your selected TECHNO-CURSE
rule (e.g. VULGRAR THRICE-CURSED operative’s
Spread the Glorious Gifts rule), it’s affected by
your additional TECHNO-CURSE rule too.

cards.text:
盖勒痘魔
阵营装备
瘟疫风箱
作为机械与凡人的混合，噩梦巨物那四处锈蚀
的烟囱，喷射气体的排气管和呼啸的风箱都不
断喷射着有毒云雾。
每当一名特工对位于其 6" 外的己方盖勒痘魔噩
梦巨物特工进行射击时，您可以将一枚掷骰结果
为 3 的防御骰作为普通成功进行保留，而不是将
其舍弃。
cards.text_en:
GELLERPOX INFECTED
FACTION EQUIPMENT
PLAGUE BELLOWS
As fusions of machine and mortal, Nightmare Hulks
bristle with rusted flumes, belching exhaust pipes
and wheezing bellows, all of which eject clouds of
noxious fumes.
Whenever an operative is shooting a friendly
GELLERPOX INFECTED NIGHTMARE HULK
operative that’s more than 6" from it, you can
retain one of your defence dice results of 3 as a
normal success instead of discarding it.
